# Support

SlopTank is a small independent fork of Jellyfin Web. Support is best-effort and there is no
guarantee of a response.

Before opening anything, please check the
[open and closed issues](https://github.com/aaron13100/SlopTank/issues?q=is%3Aissue) on this
repository, and make sure you are running the latest SlopTank build.

If that did not answer your question, open an issue here:

* [SlopTank issues](https://github.com/aaron13100/SlopTank/issues)

## Please do not ask the Jellyfin project

SlopTank is **not** affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by the Jellyfin project. Their
forum, Matrix rooms, IRC channels, subreddit, and issue tracker are for Jellyfin, and their
volunteers did not sign up to debug this fork. Reporting a SlopTank problem there wastes their
time and will not get it fixed.

The exception is a problem in the **server** you are connecting to. SlopTank talks to a Jellyfin
server, so genuine server-side questions belong in
[Jellyfin's documentation](https://jellyfin.org/docs/) and their support channels. If you are not
sure which side a problem is on, ask here first.

GitHub issues are for tracking enhancements and bugs, not general support.

The open source license grants you the freedom to use SlopTank.
It does not guarantee commitments of other people's time.
Please be respectful and manage your expectations.
